name: EFFECT
description: EFFECT returns the actual annual rate when compounding occurs more than once per year.
tldr: Calculates the effective annual interest rate from a nominal rate.

parameters.name: npery
parameters.description: Number of compounding periods per year.

basicExample.description: Effective annual rate for a 6% nominal rate compounded monthly
basicExample.explanation: A 6% nominal rate compounded monthly equals an effective annual rate of about 6.17%.

advancedExamples.title: Compare loans with different compounding
advancedExamples.explanation: Quarterly compounding gives a slightly lower effective rate than monthly compounding.

howItWorks: EFFECT uses the formula (1 + nominal_rate / npery)^npery - 1 to convert the nominal rate to the effective annual rate.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Useful for comparing loans with different compounding frequencies.

commonErrors.cause: Nominal rate was entered as a percentage instead of a decimal.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: EFFECT works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between NOMINAL and EFFECT?
faq.answer: NOMINAL converts an effective rate to a nominal rate. EFFECT converts a nominal rate to an effective rate.

faq.question: Why is the effective rate higher than the nominal rate?
faq.answer: Because interest is earned on interest within the year.
